historicalRule: P12 skipped task fields and graphVersion 1 mappings are compared to the immutable v1 snapshot, never to the meaning of reused v2 task IDs.
coverageRule: Every v2CoverageMap target must exist in the locked v2 definitions and coverage/license/CallMesh-service-model drift fails the completion checker.
repairRule: A repair task is not part of the original 57 definitions; the existing unique repairOf/appended-dependency/candidate-invalidation rules remain the only permitted graph extension.

tasks.title: Promote the unified product contract and rebaseline task state
acceptance: Workspace and Repository current docs define one product and the new read order.
A resumable owner-only campaign context exists before verification/build and inventories external gates without values.
P12 supersessions are explicit and completed history is unchanged.
next-task selects P13-T01 instead of old P12-T09.
Repository documentation tests and full verify pass.

tasks.title: Add task-state reconciliation and machine Goal completion checks
acceptance: A pushed task commit can repair an in-progress state without a duplicate commit.
Dynamic repair allocation blocks the parent, depends only on satisfied predecessors, then adds the pushed repair as a parent dependency and resumes it without a cycle.
Blocked, skipped, manual, pending, and NO_READY_TASK states cannot be mistaken for completion.
Completion checker supports the P17-T07 pre-check exclusion and mandatory post-checkpoint run while verifying origin sync, candidate identity, evidence, cleanup, and clean Repository.

tasks.title: Define unified product, runtime profile, capability, and release identity contracts
acceptance: Contracts expose one product and native/docker profiles.
Internal components report one version, commit, channel, and target identity.
Old public Desktop/Headless/CLI/Service selectors fail schema tests.

tasks.title: Promote the adopt-first v2 architecture and safely restart unfinished work
acceptance: Before any new Repository checkpoint/package/public claim, state/LICENSE_PROVENANCE.json records the owner-approved GPL-3.0-only CMClient client route, exact sources/digests/licenses/notices, approval reference and publicDevPushPermitted=true; missing, false, incompatible or malformed evidence is a hard gate.

The workspace v1-to-v2 tool canonical-transforms the draft, journals every phase, upgrades unfinished definitions in place while preserving execution metadata and history, locks historicalSupersessions/v2CoverageMap/licenseGate/callMeshServiceModel into activeGraph, and passes kill/rollback/idempotent-rerun tests.

Promotion holds a distinct graph-upgrade lock, releases task-state lock before reconcile/checkpoint/push children, reacquires it for digest validation, and passes Windows no-deadlock plus fresh-v1/local-checkpoint/pushed-v2 recovery dispatch tests.

The frozen P13-T04 diff is archived as a binary patch plus content-addressed bytes and hashes for every untracked file; a restore self-test passes before all known agent-owned product changes are removed path-scoped and later reintroduced by their owning task. No git reset --hard is used.

After the license gate permits the checkpoint, one meaningful Repository diff installs the route-appropriate LICENSE/NOTICE/provenance contract, aligns README/docs READ_ORDER, generates the full 57-task unified-task-graph-lock/v2 with canonical digest, and updates Repository-owned task-state/reconcile/next/checkpoint/repair/completion-check implementations and tests.

The approved bodies replace workspace EXECPLAN and tasks.proposed; workspace README/GOAL/root READ_ORDER plus PRODUCT_CONTRACT/RUNTIME_ONBOARDING/PLATFORM_RELEASES/VERIFICATION are updated in the same manifest so DB paths, IPC capability, Linux update paths and offline attestation have one authority. Full policy/Repository verification passes, the coherent checkpoint pushes to dev, and prior/draft plans remain dated non-normative history.

tasks.title: Prove updater-driver and private Gateway bootstrap feasibility before product refactors
acceptance: Exact Tauri CLI/core/plugin, cargo-packager-updater and fixture dependency versions, lockfile hashes, sources and licenses are frozen before testing.

A minimal independently built Tauri fixture uses createUpdaterArtifacts=v1Compatible so Tauri directly emits test-signed NSIS, app.tar.gz and AppImage-compatible updater payloads without conversion/repacking; a same-runner local HTTPS lab proves exact-format check/download/signature/install behavior.
A clean Windows standard-user fixture proves currentUser NSIS, offline/per-user WebView2, PATH/autostart hooks, repair and upgrade without UAC before P14 work proceeds.

A hidden official Tauri helper is the preferred route and is accepted only after proving exact headless AppHandle/check/download/install/relaunch, helper lifetime and replacement behavior. Public-preview cargo-packager-updater can be selected only with an explicit P13 owner risk acceptance and the same complete qualification; the final-product route cannot be deferred to P17-T08.

Gateway proves a fresh memory-only Agent bootstrap capability delivered through an inherited private pipe, never argv/env/disk/log. After validating that bounded bootstrap frame, Gateway atomically binds 127.0.0.1:0 itself and reports the bound port, child PID and instance nonce only through the inherited private channel; fixed-port probing, release/rebind and unsupported Windows descriptor passing are forbidden. Agent strips/overwrites any client capability header, Gateway rejects direct/spoofed requests on every HTTP/SSE/health route, responses never reflect it, and child identity/port-takeover tests pass.

Wrong key, bit flip, wrong target, oversize, timeout, downgrade, helper/installer death, port takeover and direct-Gateway bypass regressions pass before state/setup/backup work continues; state/UPDATER_DRIVER.json binds the final driver/version/maturity/evidence and any preview-risk approval, with no unproven fallback or custom archive/crypto path.

tasks.title: Adopt the async runtime, durable-file, lock, and logging primitives
acceptance: MSRV is 1.87 and CI verifies 1.87 plus pinned 1.96; Tokio, atomic-write-file, fs4 and tracing are exact-pinned with compatible licenses.

Missing build/test prerequisites are installed non-interactively into campaign/current-user scope with source/version/digest/license recorded; no task bypasses UAC or installs a privileged service/driver to manufacture evidence.
Typed documents and lock/log wrappers use atomic old-or-new writes, bounded retention and stable errors; fs2/custom file rotation is absent from production paths.
File write, lock contention, malformed document, rotation/redaction and crash-at-replace regressions pass without introducing process supervision, secret backend, mDNS or setup behavior.

tasks.title: Implement the exact home-root layout and the only plaintext secret backend
acceptance: All native mutable paths derive from a validated immutable startup environment snapshot home/.cmclient and Docker from /home/cmclient/.cmclient; test snapshots do not mutate the parent process environment.

config, setup state, secrets.json, root-level cmclient.db, locks, logs, backups, updates and migration paths use one RuntimePaths API and atomic old-or-new writes; legacy nested or foreign data roots are rejected.
Plaintext secrets.json is the sole runtime secret backend; no persisted Control token or secret-bearing argv/environment path exists.
No credential enters argv/env/log/API/browser/evidence/backup/Git; Unix uses 0700/0600 user-private paths and Windows uses normal current-user files without UAC or cross-principal ACL qualification.

tasks.title: Rewrite legacy state migration as a small resumable product transaction
acceptance: Node 24.18.0 current-host archive/checksum and the target staging manifest are exact-pinned; full per-target Node/native-addon build/load qualification remains P15 work.

Gateway exposes an offline maintenance command for node:sqlite backup, immutable SQL migration, integrity, FK, schema-history and domain-count reports using Agent-supplied absolute paths; Rust does not own Gateway schema/backup.
Only known config, plaintext secret, DB and backup files are inventoried within count/size bounds; links, junctions, caches, temp, services and logs are excluded.

A compact detected/staged/verified/activated/complete journal, fs4 locks, atomic writes and Gateway maintenance command support idempotent resume without modifying/deleting the source or merging a populated target.
Conflict, source mutation, digest mismatch, DB failure, and real kill at each durable boundary resume or fail with stable recovery state; the generic 2,938-line coordinator is gone.

tasks.title: Replace HTTP-over-pipe with typed framed local Control IPC
acceptance: interprocess local sockets and length-delimited Serde envelopes serve Unix socket and root-hashed Windows named-pipe endpoints with no TCP fallback.

Control has no bearer token: Unix uses a user-private 0700/0600 endpoint and Windows uses an interprocess local named pipe with remote clients disabled/PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS, without SID impersonation, custom ACL work, unsafe FFI or PID-as-identity; CLI/Desktop never read secrets.json and the old persisted/CMCLIENT_CONTROL_TOKEN paths are removed.

Version, malformed/oversize/slow/disconnect/local-command/Windows-remote-rejection/root-collision/restart/event tests pass and custom HTTP/HMAC remote-control parsing is removed; the current-user Windows product makes no cross-account isolation or foreign-account V3 claim.

tasks.title: Replace the Agent Web server and access machinery with Axum and Tower
acceptance: Axum/Tower serves static Web and Agent-owned setup/lifecycle/update SSE; Fastify @fastify/sse serves Gateway domain/job SSE only, and Agent streaming proxy preserves separate event-ID/replay namespaces and authorization.

Agent validates the Gateway bootstrap ready frame (OS-assigned port, child identity, and instance nonce), strips/overwrites every client-supplied capability header, and injects the per-start memory-only capability only after authorization. Gateway atomically binds 127.0.0.1:0 after bootstrap, rejects direct/spoofed HTTP/SSE/health requests, never reflects the capability, and port-takeover/bypass regressions pass; fixed-port probing, release/rebind, and unsupported Windows descriptor passing are forbidden.

IPv4/IPv6 wildcard bind with deterministic bind-conflict policy, Host allowlist, no wildcard CORS, default loopback admission, authenticated LAN optional CIDR, Docker-always-auth, Origin/CSRF, generation/session revocation, rate limit, HTTP-LAN warning and redacted audit tests pass.
The handwritten HTTP parser/static/TLS/session/rate-limit implementation is absent and no second auth authority exists in Gateway.

tasks.title: Run the adopt-first runtime, migration, access, and license gate
acceptance: Fresh, migrated, conflict, crash-resume, no-system-Node, local Control, Web admission/auth and real Agent/Gateway process E2E pass on current Windows plus applicable CI targets.

Dependency decision and license inventory records exact version/license/upstream/digest and proves compatibility with the owner-approved GPL-3.0-only CMClient client route; no checkpoint continues without the evidence required by P13-T04.
Full verify, MSRV/current Rust, Node 24 production tests, secret/license scans and clean checkpoint push pass.

tasks.title: Implement authoritative setup state and passive Meshtastic discovery/validation
acceptance: Agent setup state is versioned, generation-fenced and survives restart; missing/invalid/revoked/reset key enters setupRequired before Gateway external work or APRS TX.
Discovery checks migrated endpoint, loopback 4403, bounded _meshtastic._tcp.local browse, then manual input; there is no LAN scan.
Validation requests/observes configuration only and tests prove no MeshPacket, admin/config mutation, RF command or radio change.

tasks.title: Expose setup-only API, durable Jobs, and adopted SSE contracts
acceptance: Agent exposes only the allowed setup/reset/status surface until ready; TypeBox/OpenAPI snapshots bind Web, Agent and Gateway contracts.

Axum owns Agent setup/lifecycle/update SSE; @fastify/sse owns Gateway domain and durable-Job SSE only. The Agent proxy preserves the Gateway stream bytes and keeps separate route namespaces, event IDs, replay stores, authorization, and reconnect contracts.

p-queue schedules SQLite-authoritative Jobs; Last-Event-ID, unknown/expired ID, subscriber cap, slow consumer, restart recovery, idempotency and setup-generation fence tests pass for each event namespace.
Gateway HTTP, SSE, and health routes require the fresh Agent bootstrap capability from P13-T05; a direct loopback request without it is rejected and no capability appears in argv/env/disk/logs.

tasks.title: Build the full Web setup wizard with XState and PrimeVue Forms
acceptance: The wizard covers terms, discovered/manual Meshtastic, CallMesh API key, provision/default review, validation, finish, resume and recovery through Agent state only; the official CallMesh endpoint and mapping authority are fixed and never shown as editable fields.
XState view flow and PrimeVue field errors do not persist credentials or create a second authority; fresh/resume/offline/invalid/revoked/terms-change Playwright and model tests pass.
Completion atomically transitions to ready and opens the full management Web.

tasks.title: Implement operational reset and isolated factory reset
acceptance: Reset rotates the setup generation, revokes sessions, stops external work, clears secrets/config selections, preserves documented user data, and returns to setupRequired.
Factory reset is fixture-safe, explicit, staged and never deletes arbitrary real roots; interrupted phases recover deterministically.
Old jobs/events/connections cannot commit after the generation change and no credential enters evidence.

tasks.title: Adopt process-wrap supervision and unify resident lifecycle
acceptance: Agent supervises exact private Node/Gateway through process-wrap Job Object/process group/session with bounded restart and graceful shutdown.
Agent hard-kill, Gateway crash loop, blocked stdout/stderr, update maintenance child and repeated start/stop leave no orphan, zombie, duplicate listener or duplicate DB writer.
Windows service-host/SCM and system service assumptions are not normal-product runtime dependencies.

tasks.title: Integrate one installed product launcher, compact Desktop, and command mode
acceptance: One installed product supplies click-to-GUI and terminal cmclient entrypoints; internal binaries are hidden implementation details, not separate products.
Desktop is limited to tray, compact status, open Web, lifecycle/update commands and notifications; close hides by default and quit respects resident settings.
CLI/Desktop operate only through Control, share version/capability/error contracts, and repeated launches keep one Agent/Desktop instance.

tasks.title: Implement current-user login autostart and Web controls on all native platforms
acceptance: Windows HKCU, macOS SMAppService through objc2 bindings, and Linux XDG autostart start --background by default with no UAC/root; systemd-user is explicit fallback only.
Web autostart status/toggle reports enabled, approval-required, missing/stale and repair states and repairs moved install paths idempotently.

The management Web listener is enabled by default and independently toggleable; disabling closes IPv4/IPv6 listeners and revokes Web sessions while Agent/Control remain resident, and Desktop/CLI can re-enable it.
Enable/disable/reinstall/upgrade/uninstall fixture matrices pass per target without duplicate resident cores.

tasks.title: Implement backup and staged restore through Gateway SQLite maintenance
acceptance: Backup uses node:sqlite backup and a manifest for config/setup/DB while excluding secrets/run/updates/sessions/staging/cache/live logs.
Restore verifies digests, schema/integrity/FK/domain reports in staging, quiesces Gateway, atomically activates, rotates generation and revalidates credentials.
Cancel/retry/retention, corrupt backup, killed restore and exact rollback tests pass without touching a real user root.

tasks.title: Expose Agent-owned update preference, trigger, Job, and surface controls
acceptance: Agent persists update preference and exposes available/check/download/install/rollback status through setup-aware Jobs without packaging or installing itself.
Web, Desktop, and CLI use the same Agent Job/control contract; Docker exposes only the operator-side digest workflow and hides native self-update controls.
The driver selected by the P13-T05 fixture spike is displayed honestly; full product payload, external watchdog, health gate, and exact rollback remain P15-T02.

tasks.title: Share one Meshtastic upstream across ingest and protocol-aware Proxy clients
acceptance: Ingest and every Proxy client share one transport/config session; no client receives or controls the raw upstream socket.
Config cache/replay, request and ACK ownership, slow-client bounded queues, reconnect, generation reset and ordering are protocol-aware and deterministic.
Two-plus-client real TCP and property tests cover collisions, disconnects, backpressure and no duplicate domain/APRS event.

tasks.title: Finish trusted CallMesh mapping and verified APRS-IS transmission gates
acceptance: The official hosted CallMesh service is the only production provision/mapping authority for every native and Docker client; production config/UI expose no self-host endpoint, alternate server, imported/manual/local mapping, override or merge path, while automated tests use dependency-injected fixtures unavailable in production.

CallMesh retries use fetch/p-retry, but schema, atomic complete-snapshot commit, canonical response digest, revision/effective-time/lease handling, mapping high-water, provision transaction and trusted source-event-time selection remain CMClient-owned.
An outage may use only the last committed CallMesh snapshot while freshness and temporal validity prove it applicable; otherwise provision and APRS transmission fail closed.
APRS deterministic golden vectors remain byte-identical; differential parser tests cannot authorize TX.
No first packet is sent until canonical callsign matching verified logresp; mismatch, unverified, timeout, rotation and reconnect fail closed.

tasks.title: Run the complete setup, lifecycle, backup, Proxy, CallMesh, and APRS gate
acceptance: Fresh/setup/reset/resume, Web/Desktop/CLI, autostart, private Node supervision, backup/restore, shared upstream/Proxy and CallMesh/APRS fixture E2E all pass.
All retained P12 defects have failing-then-passing regressions and real-process tests where applicable.
Full verify, secret/license scans and clean pushed checkpoint pass before packaging work.

tasks.title: Establish target-native build lanes and candidate signing profiles
acceptance: Static Windows x64, macOS x64/arm64, Linux x64/arm64 lanes pin Rust/Node/pnpm/system tools and build target-only native dependencies.
Development unsigned/ad-hoc/test-signed lanes are distinct from optional production signing and never infer real foreign-host evidence.
Build/runtime/package output is campaign-temp scoped and no lane downloads/reassembles another GitHub artifact.

tasks.title: Create one canonical profile manifest and target-native Tauri staging trees
acceptance: One deterministic product/profile manifest identifies shared Agent/CLI/Gateway/Web/private-Node inputs and exact native-versus-Docker inclusion/exclusion; each native target stage adds GUI/updater helpers, licenses, migrations and terms.

Tauri platform config overlays are the only consumers of native staging trees. Docker later builds its own GUI-free stage from the shared profile manifest and never copies a Tauri stage, app bundle, sidecar layout or updater helper.
Missing system Node/npm, wrong architecture/native addon, extra public binary and source-identity mismatch smokes fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement external update coordinator, watchdog, health gate, and exact rollback
acceptance: The selected maintained updater driver owns check/download/signature/install; CMClient owns only durable job, state backup, quiesce, external watchdog, health and rollback.
The prior exact installer/app/AppImage remains available through health commit and every mutable phase supports kill/resume.
Good, corrupt, wrong-target, interrupted, unhealthy-new and failed-rollback labs verify either new exact version or restored old exact version/state.

tasks.title: Produce one current-user Windows x64 Setup executable
acceptance: Tauri NSIS currentUser produces exactly CMClient-Setup.exe with offline WebView2, Start menu GUI, terminal command, all internal components and no normal UAC.
Installer hooks create/repair PATH and HKCU autostart; upgrade/uninstall keep ~/.cmclient unless explicit user reset and remove integrations idempotently.
No MSI, portable archive, separate Desktop/CLI installer or system service is public.

tasks.title: Qualify the Windows x64 Setup and lifecycle lab
acceptance: Fresh install, Next-flow, no-UAC, GUI, CLI, Web setup, background login start, upgrade, unhealthy rollback, repair, uninstall/reinstall and state migration pass from the exact Setup.
Agent hard-kill, locked files, stale PATH/autostart and previous-version rollback leave no orphan or duplicate core.
Current Windows Server evidence is labeled as such and is not represented as Windows 11.

tasks.title: Build Universal macOS app resources without rebuilding Node binaries
acceptance: The Universal Tauri app includes native Rust slices and separate verified official Node x64/arm64 production trees selected at runtime, not lipo-rebuilt Node.
Both architecture resource manifests, serial native addons, JIT/signing entitlements and updater helper layout pass structural/native-load CI checks.
Ad-hoc/test signing is explicit and production Developer ID/notarization remains optional manual work.

tasks.title: Produce one Universal DMG with user CLI and SMAppService integration
acceptance: Tauri builds one CMClient.dmg with drag-to-Applications layout and one complete app product.

First run installs/repairs a reversible ~/.local/bin/cmclient shim and SMAppService status/toggle without administrator access; a fresh supported login shell resolves cmclient without manual PATH editing or destructive profile replacement.
Update/rollback preserves prior app, repairs integration and verifies the exact restored/new version.

tasks.title: Qualify Universal DMG structure and native lifecycle evidence
acceptance: DMG/app slices, resources, signatures, Node/native addon selection, CLI shim, SMAppService, migration and update/rollback fixtures pass.
Real Intel and Apple Silicon installed V3 rows remain optional/manual unless executed on those named hosts; CI structure/cross-build is not relabeled.

tasks.title: Build the complete Linux x86-64 AppImage product
acceptance: Tauri emits one target-native x86-64 AppImage containing the complete product/private Node and no DEB/RPM split.

A host without system Node starts from the packaged runtime, CLI arguments dispatch command mode while no arguments open the compact GUI, and the package contains only x86-64 native dependencies. XDG integration and versioned update/rollback are verified by P15-T10, not this package-composition task.

Clean Ubuntu 22.04 and Debian 12 class lanes install only the documented WebKitGTK/GTK/indicator/OpenSSL/glibc runtime prerequisites, pass GUI/Agent/CLI/native-addon launch, and fail preflight with an actionable dependency report when a prerequisite is missing; AppImage is not mislabeled fully self-contained.

tasks.title: Build the complete Linux ARM64 AppImage product
acceptance: Tauri emits one target-native ARM64 AppImage with ARM Node/native dependencies and no foreign addon fallback.

Architecture inspection and native-load or controlled-emulation rows are labeled exactly; real ARM V3 remains optional/manual until executed. XDG integration and versioned update/rollback are verified by P15-T10.

The documented Ubuntu 22.04/Debian 12 runtime prerequisite matrix is architecture-qualified; clean ARM64 native or honestly labeled emulated lanes prove dependency preflight, GUI/Agent/CLI startup and native-addon load without claiming V3 from emulation.

tasks.title: Implement Linux XDG integration and versioned AppImage rollback
acceptance: First run repairs desktop entry, icon, ~/.local/bin/cmclient and XDG autostart; a fresh supported login shell resolves cmclient without destructive profile replacement, and systemd-user is a mutually exclusive explicit headless fallback.

Updates keep versioned AppImages and the current pointer under ~/.cmclient/updates/releases and atomically switch there; unhealthy update switches to the prior exact AppImage and state. Only reversible shell/XDG integration files live outside ~/.cmclient.
Moved file, no-FUSE extraction fallback, disabled autostart, uninstall integration and kill-at-switch fixtures pass for both architectures.

tasks.title: Run the complete native install, migration, update, rollback, and retention matrix
acceptance: Every required V0-V2 target row and available honest V3 row covers install, setup, GUI/CLI/Web, autostart, state migration, backup, update, rollback and uninstall retention.
No package requires system Node/npm, elevated normal lifecycle, another public component package or downloaded/reassembled GitHub artifact.

tasks.title: Run the full native distribution verification gate
acceptance: Native schema, package policies, install smokes, updater labs, source/runtime identity, full verify, secret/license scans and clean push all pass.
Unavailable real foreign targets and production signing remain explicit pending manual rows.

tasks.title: Manually qualify native packages on real foreign targets
acceptance: Install and run exact packages on named Windows 11, Intel/Apple Silicon macOS and x64/ARM64 Linux hosts when available.
Never infer a real V3 pass from the current Windows Server host, cross-build, structure check, Rosetta, QEMU or another architecture.

tasks.title: Build one non-root unified Docker container under Docker init
acceptance: One service/container contains Agent, CLI, Web, Gateway and pinned Node but no Desktop or CallMesh server/self-host component; Rust Agent is exec-form entrypoint and Compose init:true supplies PID1 reaping.
Docker assembles a separate stage from the P15-T01 shared profile manifest; Tauri GUI resources, app bundle metadata, native updater helpers and foreign-target dependencies are absent.
UID 10001, read-only root, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, one state volume/bounded tmpfs and no socket/device/host/privileged mode pass inspection.
Old gateway/web/ingress multi-service and Node entrypoint contracts are removed.

tasks.title: Implement Docker state, authenticated setup, and local host publishing
acceptance: All state is /home/cmclient/.cmclient on the named volume and survives restart, recreate, and docker compose down when --volumes is not supplied; UID 10001 performs atomic writes and down --volumes is documented as destructive.
Compose publishes host_ip 127.0.0.1 by default and every Docker Web session authenticates; LAN requires both widened publish and enabled LAN policy.
One-time setup code is available only through docker compose exec CLI and never environment/log/URL/diagnostics/evidence.
When the management Web listener is disabled, docker compose exec command mode can inspect and re-enable it while local Control remains healthy.

tasks.title: Qualify Docker signals, reaping, health, and restart behavior
acceptance: SIGTERM reaches Agent, Gateway shuts down within stop grace, repeated crashes leave no zombie/orphan, and fatal Agent exit increments restart count.
Health is read-only through local Control, setupRequired is healthy, and unhealthy status alone is not claimed to trigger Docker restart.

tasks.title: Qualify Docker setup, CLI, Web, backup/restore, and state E2E
acceptance: Compose exec command mode uses Control for setup/status/reset/backup/restore and no direct DB/secret access.
Default local publish, authenticated widened publish, setup generation, DB/WAL, backup/restore, restart/recreate and redaction pass.
Docker Engine older than the approved localhost behavior fails qualification instead of being represented as safe.

tasks.title: Build and inspect one amd64/arm64 OCI index with native child identities
acceptance: Native or honestly labeled controlled lanes build immutable linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 child digests and one exact OCI index; any push is limited to a campaign-local ephemeral or CI-controlled registry, never an assumed public registry.
imagetools inspection proves exactly two targets and binds Rust/Node/native addon/runtime identities plus index/child digests.
No index job downloads image payload layers; QEMU/cross-build evidence is labeled V0-V2 and never real native V3.

tasks.title: Implement operator-side Docker digest update and rollback
acceptance: Host workflow records old digest, pulls/recreates exact new digest with the same volume, health-checks, and pins/recreates old digest on failure.
Container has no self-update or Docker socket/API; old image remains through commit and state survives good/bad update.

tasks.title: Reduce the release schema to the unified public install objects
acceptance: Public choices are Windows Setup, Universal DMG, two AppImages, one OCI index and Compose; signatures/checksums/SBOM/provenance/update files are support objects.
Old MSI/portable/DEB/component selectors fail policy tests and release-artifacts becomes a small schema/index validator rather than a packager.

tasks.title: Replace artifact collectors with same-runner build, test, SBOM, attest, and upload jobs
acceptance: Each static target job builds, test-signs only when needed, packages, installs/tests, hashes, SBOMs, creates a local offline Cosign blob/attestation bundle and optionally retains its exact final object as one workflow artifact on one runner.
No downstream download-artifact, merge-multiple, overlay, repack or byte finalizer exists; index job consumes metadata outputs only.

No autonomous job calls actions/attest, writes a public transparency log, creates/updates a GitHub Release or publishes a package; production attestation/signing/tag/release upload is an explicit protected human workflow and new signed bytes require new qualification.

tasks.title: Bind exact native and OCI subjects to checksums, SBOM, provenance, and signing status
acceptance: Checksum-pinned Syft scans final native stages; BuildKit emits OCI SBOM/provenance in the controlled registry; pinned Cosign uses a campaign-local test key to bind exact native blobs and the OCI index with transparency/network upload disabled.
Release index records source, size, digest, SBOM digest, attestation identity and signing status without consuming payload bytes.

Post-attestation repack, missing target, identity mismatch, unresolved license evidence, public attestation/release mutation, and substituted subject fail closed; actions/attest and keyless transparency are reserved for P17-T08.

tasks.title: Run the complete native package and Docker candidate matrix
acceptance: Every required target has exact V0-V2 evidence and only actually executed real hosts have V3; package/Docker install, setup, access, autostart, update/rollback, uninstall/state cases pass.
No current-Windows, cross-build, QEMU or manifest evidence is represented as another platform or production release.

tasks.title: Run the full unified distribution and release-policy gate
acceptance: Full verify, policy, package, Docker, load, supply-chain, license/provenance, docs and secret scans pass with exact evidence references.
No main change, tag, production sign/notarize, publication or GitHub artifact download occurs.

tasks.title: Manually qualify OCI children on real amd64 and arm64 hosts
acceptance: Run each exact child digest on named real amd64 and arm64 hosts and record native runtime/product evidence.
Do not infer real ARM or amd64 evidence from cross-build, QEMU, index inspection or another host.

tasks.title: Revalidate every live testability gate in the isolated Windows campaign
acceptance: All applicable TG gates pass against exact local source/runtime; optional hosts/signing/Docker/hardware are inventoried by boolean/reason only and independent work continues.
Every child HOME/USERPROFILE/TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR and build/runtime/package/DB/capture/update-lab path is inside the owner-user campaign temp root.
Approved credentials/endpoints are checked without values, public exposure, external mutation, RF or radio change.

tasks.title: Qualify passive Meshtastic TCP, CallMesh provision, and verified APRS-IS
acceptance: Passive TCP 4403 config/live/reconnect and sanitized replay pass without RF or radio mutation.

The exact candidate uses the official CallMesh service for Legacy-compatible heartbeat/mapping/provision, records the authoritative snapshot identity, and passes canonical matching verified APRS login; only authorized provision-derived flow may transmit and no server/mapping override is used.
Evidence contains no credential, identity, precise private location or raw sensitive packet data.

tasks.title: Qualify multi-client Proxy, full Web, compact Desktop, and command mode
acceptance: At least two local Proxy clients share one upstream and pass config/ACK/slow/reconnect/order cases.
All full Web workflows, compact Desktop controls and CLI paths use the same resident Agent and installed product.
Repeated lifecycle operations produce no duplicate process, event, DB write or APRS output.

tasks.title: Qualify persistence, reset, backup/restore, update/rollback, and recovery
acceptance: Restart/WAL/integrity, operational reset/re-setup, backup/restore manifests/exclusions/staging and generation fences pass.
Local test-signed update lab covers every interrupted phase, corrupt/wrong/unhealthy candidate and exact prior-version/state rollback.
No real user state, production release resource or external admin/radio state is mutated.

tasks.title: Complete the continuous 24-hour unified-product live soak
acceptance: A continuous 24-hour exact-candidate run records bounded health/RSS/handles/threads/DB/WAL/log/upstream/client metrics.
No duplicate domain/APRS event, position rollback, secret leak, unbounded growth, orphan or stale generation commit occurs.

definitionAmendments.reason: Node 24.18.0 does not support adopting a file-descriptor TCP listener or passing sockets through child stdio on Windows. Atomic child port-zero bind plus a private ready frame preserves the no-takeover invariant without a native libuv bridge or release/rebind fallback.

evidence.finding: Listening on a file descriptor is not supported on Windows.
Sending IPC sockets is not supported on Windows.
